related_work: I learned HTML and CSS from Alice, which was very helpful for building my website. My project was to create a game controller, so I researched relevant references on game controllers from peer-reviewed sources, news articles, government agencies, Mintel, and business publications. After reviewing this material, I discovered that a particularly high percentage of people simply throw away electronic devices after use rather than repairing or recycling them, which causes significant environmental pollution. Furthermore, the joysticks on game controllers are very prone to breaking. What shocked me even more was that child labor is used in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to produce electronic components, resulting in serious injuries to children. In addition, I created mood boards to define my design style.
title: week2
introduction: This week we learned about HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I learned that HTML provides the framework for a web page, CSS changes its appearance, and JavaScript enables interactivity. Writing this code can result in a website, which really excites me. Boyd had us draw cards at random to get inspiration and think about the projects we wanted to work on. That was a lot of fun. My Project 0 is to build a game controller, and I’ve done some literature review and created a mood board for it.
